collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — FEARS AND DOUBTS (FEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fears big and small, sensible and not, self-doubt, feeling like a fraud, dread with no reason, wanting and fearing the same thing, and courage that is still frightened. Nobody has to be brave, nobody is mocked, and a fear does not have to be conquered by the end.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A villager who does the finest work fears their eyesight is fading: ask the healer, or work only in the morning light.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has always done the finest work in the village: the tiniest stitches, the most delicate carving. Lately the fine lines have begun to blur, especially in the evenings. (subject.He/she) is frightened that (subject.his/her) eyes are going, and that (subject.he/she) will lose the thing (subject.he/she) loves most. (subject.He/she) hasn't told anyone. (friend) notices (subject.him/her) squinting.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) goes to (healer), the healer, who looks at (subject.his/her) eyes and says this happens to many people with time. (healer) fetches a smooth, clear, rounded stone, polished thin. Held close, it makes the fine lines bigger. It isn't the same as before. It's slower and more awkward. But (subject) can still do the work. (subject.He/she) holds the stone very carefully.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) decides to do the fine work only in the bright morning, and simpler work in the afternoons. It helps, mostly. Some days the lines blur anyway. (subject.He/she) is still frightened, some evenings. (subject.He/she) tells (friend), finally. (friend) says, "Then I'll thread your needles," and does, every evening, without being asked.
